noise_free_gate: training position RMSE < 1e-5 OR remaining < 40 seconds
noisy_gate: training AND same-law independent-validation position RMSE < 0.1 OR remaining < 60 seconds; next action must submit at remaining < 40 seconds
changes: Bounded polynomial expansion and commutative algebraic deduplication before joint parameter sharing; preserve distinct operator families and matching scalar hypotheses. No sample-agreement-only deduplication or domain-changing denominator cancellation.

Return up to three complete ranked laws with fitted parameters and separately labelled acceleration-search, observed-velocity-integral and trajectory-refit residuals. Time-bounded numerical refit, no automatic law registration/submission.

Local resolution-quality weights retain all observed samples with equal total weight per probe. Public-noise-conditioned local cubic smoothing only when the corresponding observation sigma is positive.

Data-supported radial projection retains full Cartesian search, adds a low-dimensional position/property branch and sign-checked generic log-response regression. No world id, truth constants, exact labels or reference-force templates. All sin/cos/exp/log/power operators remain enabled.
Frozen-law consistency feedback on all acquired observations at fit/save; inspected observations become discovery data and cannot be relabelled independent validation.
Noisy gate enforced by runtime, model tool restriction and explicit submission of an already model-selected draft when below 40 seconds. Clean post-session evaluation metadata explicit.
prechecks: Existing R02 W4/W5 expression/observation diagnostics v1-v3 retained separately; these are engineering checks, not new autonomous scores or official reevaluations. W5 v3 complete five-parameter formula training position RMSE 8.57e-9. W4 remains unresolved in these checks.
selection_policy: All twelve attempts retained, no per-world retries or interim source tuning.
